'''Arts and culture'''
*''[[Strictly Come Dancing (series 20)|Strictly Come Dancing]]''
**Wildlife presenter [[Hamza Yassin]] and his professional partner [[Jowita Przystał|Jowita Przystal]] win the coveted glitterball trophy despite a few mistakes and landing in the bottom of the leaderboard. [https://www.bbc.com/news/entertainment-arts-63943808 (BBC News)]
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Yemeni Civil War (2014–present)|Yemeni Civil War]]
**Three people are killed and another is injured in a [[landmine]] [[explosion]] in [[Al Hudaydah]], [[Yemen]]. [https://en.mehrnews.com/news/195012/Landmine-explosion-in-Yemen-kills-3-including-2-children (Mehr News)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economy of Uzbekistan]]
**[[Uzbekistan]] announces a nearly [[USD|$]]1 billion loan from the two main [[World Bank]] lending institutions, aimed at supporting the country's transition to a [[private sector]]-led economy. [https://english.news.cn/20221217/e802a5f5361b49a99802384d22e4f0d5/c.html (Xinhua)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Five people are killed and five others are injured in a [[head-on collision]] of a bus and a [[pickup truck]] near [[Ventersburg]], [[Free State (province)|Free State]], [[South Africa]]. [https://www.newzimbabwe.com/sa-five-killed-as-bus-headed-to-zimbabwe-in-head-on-collision/ (NewZimbabwe)]
*Three people are killed and 17 others are injured by a [[freak wave]] at a beach in [[Durban]], [[KwaZulu-Natal]], [[South Africa]]. [https://www.voanews.com/a/killed-17-injured-by-freak-wave-at-south-african-beach-/6880863.html (VOA)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Dresden Green Vault burglary]]
**German authorities recover 31 [[Crown jewels|royal jewellery]] items that were stolen from the [[Green Vault]] museum at [[Dresden Castle]] in [[Dresden]], [[Saxony]], [[Germany]], in 2019. [https://www.scmp.com/news/world/europe/article/3203714/germany-finds-most-items-stolen-2019-dresden-jewellery-robbery-police-say (AFP via ''South China Morning Post'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2022 Tunisian parliamentary election]]
**[[Tunisians]] head to the polls to elect the members of the [[Assembly of the Representatives of the People]]. Opposition parties have called for a [[boycott]] of the election. [https://www.theeastafrican.co.ke/tea/rest-of-africa/tunisians-to-vote-on-toothless-parliament-4058028 (AFP via ''The East African'')]
*[[2022 Fijian general election]]
**[[Fiji]]'s election office projects that both the ruling [[FijiFirst]] and opposition [[People's Alliance (Fiji)|People's Alliance]] parties will win 26 seats each in the 55-seat [[Parliament of Fiji|parliament]], resulting in a [[Gridlock (politics)|deadlock]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/fiji-election-results-show-parliamentary-deadlock/a-64138157 (DW)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2022 FIFA World Cup]]
**[[Croatia national football team|Croatia]] [[2022 FIFA World Cup knockout stage#Third place play-off|defeats]] [[Morocco national football team|Morocco]] 2–1 in the third place play-off. This is Croatia's second third-place finish, and Morocco's best ever result at a [[FIFA World Cup|World Cup]], which is also the best ever result by both an [[Confederation of African Football|African]] and [[Union of Arab Football Associations|Arab]] team at the tournament. [http://edition.cnn.com/2022/12/17/football/croatia-morocco-third-place-playoff-2022-world-cup-spt-intl/index.html (CNN)]
*[[2022 NFL season]]
**The [[2022 Minnesota Vikings season|Minnesota Vikings]] complete the [[2022 Indianapolis Colts–Minnesota Vikings game|largest comeback]] in [[National Football League|NFL]] history against the [[2022 Indianapolis Colts season|Indianapolis Colts]], winning 39–36 after a 0–33 deficit. The [[The Comeback (American football)|previous largest comeback]] occurred in January 1993 when the [[1992 Buffalo Bills season|Buffalo Bills]] won 41–38 against the [[1992 Houston Oilers season|Houston Oilers]] after a 35–3 deficit. [https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/vikings-vs-colts-score-minnesota-completes-largest-comeback-in-nfl-history-clinches-nfc-north/live/?ref=upstract.com (CBS Sports)]
